subject: A occurrence
exact_binding: Stable bounded identity at a source-owned authoritative admission
prohibited_substitution: Never a,n,proof hash, transport ID or actor key by default

subject: Action type / governing identities
exact_binding: One exact type meaning and governed generation/specification/profile references
prohibited_substitution: Draft type description is not published namespace allocation

subject: PI
exact_binding: Exactly n,a,r and fixed source meanings
prohibited_substitution: Internal a,n,r tuple does not reorder PI

subject: R
exact_binding: Complete fixed source-derived applicable rule set before E
prohibited_substitution: No runtime rule insertion or omitted unresolved condition

subject: Proof/domain/artifact context
exact_binding: Same proof relation, nullifier domain and coherent artifacts bound to PI
prohibited_substitution: No false-as-inability conflation; no changed verifier under E

subject: Membership root context
exact_binding: Selected policy, stable membership scope, valid authoritative introductions and relevant cut
prohibited_substitution: Latest16 counts introductions; no sentinel privilege or padding inference

subject: Scoped uniqueness context
exact_binding: Exact a,n,valid used state and coherent observation boundary
prohibited_substitution: Absence is not FALSE; new A does not create a new uniqueness scope

subject: Other applicable conditions
prohibited_substitution: No clock/finality/product default; full applicability still required

subject: E/D joins
exact_binding: E binds A/R/C; D produced only at complete E and binds same A/R/C
prohibited_substitution: No delivery failure rewrites E/D; no partial classification

subject: Authorization/U joins
prohibited_substitution: B supplies no registry row, source appointment or authorization

subject: Disclosure/custody
exact_binding: Authorized source/validation boundary and exact permitted result surfaces
prohibited_substitution: No new public chain of A/E/D/U or acquisition topology
